function.arguments: {"answer": "The email campaign had a conversion rate that was 10.1 percentage points lower than paid search, after adjusting for customer segment.", "value": -0.1011, "method": "To estimate the causal effect of channel on conversion, we first excluded six QA orders (revenue = 999999.99) and all refunded orders (status = 'refunded'), as they are not valid for measuring conversion.
